script.base: Closing line makes GB a 3-point road favorite with implied totals GB 24.8 and PIT 21.8, so the book expects a competitive game, not a blowout, at a middling 46.5. GB's recent shape is Jacobs as the lead back (53 carries, 234 yards in weeks 4/6/7) with Love spreading to Doubs (25 targets, 295 air yards), Kraft and Golden; PIT splits Gainwell 28/135 and Warren 27/179 and funnels throws to Metcalf (19 targets, 271 yards). Slight GB lead late should add Jacobs carries without a garbage-time pass festival.
script.flip1: GB scores early, protects a multi-score lead, and clocks out with Jacobs and Wilson, so Love, Doubs and Golden yards stall while PIT abandons the run and Metcalf's targets spike.
script.flip2: PIT stays in it or leads at home, both quarterbacks throw, Jacobs's carries dip and his rush-plus-rec number has to come from checkdowns, and Doubs, Kraft and Metcalf all get full-game volume. Unknown outdoor weather is the other path to a lower-event game.
